## Change
Describe the concrete problem and resulting behavior.

## Scope
Which module and user-visible behavior changed? Mention routing/privacy/signing changes explicitly.

## Verification
List exact commands and outcomes; link CI and commit. Distinguish core, build and device checks. State any checks not run and why.

## Remaining limits
List unresolved behavior or release blockers. Do not label source-only features as tested.

## Handoff
Update docs/STATUS.md and relevant architecture/decisions when facts changed. Confirm the diff preserves unrelated work and contains no credentials or personal data.
